worlds.name: Picture Garden
worlds.lore: A quiet garden at the start of the road: fruit, sweets, animals and old paintings, each one dug out a block at a time.

map.note: Fix pass (Peter): Kitten Forest’s two sheets (no new image bytes), in a different turn and tint from World 2 so the join never shows one sheet twice: B mirrored, A mirrored, B, A mirrored, B, then (v6 lane D15, 50 levels) A mirrored, B (World 2 starts on A). 50 levels: 8 then 7 a sheet (spot 5 skipped, which leaves no wider gap than a sheet join). Eggs at the painted side-quest spurs’ tips.

worlds.name: Kitten Forest
worlds.lore: Past the Garden the road runs on into a lantern-lit wood of giant toadstools, where kittens nap, play and make mischief in every glade.

worlds.name: Snack Galaxy
worlds.lore: The road drifts up into a starry sky of donut planets and cheese moons, where snacks, kittens and the odd dinosaur float by at their own pace.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 2 (02-snack-galaxy) as Zen World 3, its own sheets (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Dino Valley
worlds.lore: The road comes back down to earth in a warm green valley of ferns, rivers and smoking volcanoes, where dinosaurs fish, play music and get up to all sorts of things.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 3 (05-dino-valley) as Zen World 4, its own sheets (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Masterpiece Gallery
worlds.lore: The road wanders into a sunny riverside of famous old paintings, from a Sunday on La Grande Jatte to Van Gogh's bedroom, each one waiting to be dug out a block at a time.
worlds.credit: Masterpiece Gallery: Public domain paintings from the Art Institute of Chicago, National Gallery of Art, The Met and Cleveland Museum of Art open access (CC0).

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 4 (06-masterpiece-gallery) as Zen World 5, the game's sheets sheet-02.webp and sheet-05.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: The Floating World
worlds.lore: The road climbs from old Edo to Mount Fuji, with flowers, fish and birds along the way, all from Hokusai's and Hiroshige's woodblock prints and waiting to be dug out a block at a time.
worlds.credit: The Floating World: Japanese woodblock prints by Katsushika Hokusai and Utagawa Hiroshige from the Art Institute of Chicago open access (CC0); most adapted for the game by Click it! Studios.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 5 (07-floating-world) as Zen World 6, the game's sheets sheet-07.webp and sheet-01.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Under the Sea
worlds.lore: The road dives under the waves, where octopuses play drums, deep-sea fish glow in the dark, volcanoes smoke on the sea floor, aliens drop by and old ships sail at night, with a sunny beach or two on the way.
worlds.credit: Under the Sea: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 6 (08-under-the-sea) as Zen World 7, the game's sheets sheet-14.webp and sheet-15.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Poster Parade
worlds.lore: The road heads out on a parade of old travel and park posters from the 1920s-40s: geysers, peaks and forests, wild animals and zoo animals, ski trails and snowy days, each one dug out a block at a time.
worlds.credit: Poster Parade: 1920s-40s WPA and travel posters from the Library of Congress (no known restrictions on publication).

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 7 (09-national-park-posters) as Zen World 8, the game's sheets sheet-09.webp and sheet-08.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Puppy Park
worlds.lore: The road wanders into a sunny park full of happy dogs: goofy grins, floppy ears, party hats and muddy noses, with a bath, a car ride and a stolen picnic on the way.
worlds.credit: Puppy Park: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 8 (11-puppy-park) as Zen World 9, the game's sheets sheet-03.webp and sheet-11.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Harvest Festival
worlds.lore: The road rolls into a cozy autumn fair: smiling pumpkins, friendly little ghosts, owls and black cats, kids in costumes, apples, pies and a big harvest feast, with sunflowers and hay bales all along the way.
worlds.credit: Harvest Festival: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.

map.note: v6 lane D: Land 9 (12-harvest-festival) as Zen World 10, the game's sheets sheet-12.webp and sheet-21.webp reused under its own tint (map.reuse, no new image bytes) (tools/land.js zen).

worlds.name: Cloud Kingdom
worlds.lore: The road climbs up above the clouds: hot-air balloons and kites, birds of every kind, rainbows, a dragon kite and a rocket, and a palace sitting right on top of the clouds.
worlds.credit: Cloud Kingdom: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.

worlds.name: Clockwork Town
worlds.lore: A town that runs on gears and steam: clockwork owls and wind-up mice, robot pets, ticking clocks and pocket watches, a steam train, a submarine and a zeppelin, all in brass and copper.
worlds.credit: Clockwork Town: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.

worlds.name: Holiday Lights
worlds.lore: The road winds into a snowy wood lit up for the winter holidays: twinkling trees and wrapped presents, snowmen and snow angels, penguins, foxes and polar bear cubs, cozy mittens and a crackling cabin, and a clock ticking down to a new year that everyone can join.
worlds.credit: Holiday Lights: original pictures generated with FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache 2.0) by Click it! Studios.
